title: Target Transformation:
prompt: **Target Transformation:** If transforming a feature $X \to \log(X)$ does NOT change a Decision Tree, does transforming the *target variable* $Y \to \log(Y)$ change a Regression Tree trained with MSE loss? (Yes! Because $\frac{1}{N}\sum (y_i - c)^2$ vs $\frac{1}{N}\sum (\log y_i - c)^2$ changes the optimal leaf value from arithmetic mean to geometric mean and alters split gains).
